faq.question: How long does shipping take?
faq.answer: Orders within the EU are delivered in 5 to 7 business days. Express shipping in 2 business days costs 60 EUR.

faq.question: Can I return a product?
faq.answer: Unused products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to fly the Drone X1?
faq.answer: Customers are responsible for local aviation rules. In the EU the Drone X1 falls under the open category, subcategory A2.

faq.question: Can I export my data?
faq.answer: Flight logs can be exported as CSV from Fleet Cloud at any time, and fleet maps as GeoJSON.
